design.prompt: Archive the workspace channel whose topic covers Kubernetes, AWS, and on-call incident response — we're folding it into a broader ops channel.
design.binding_note: The target channel is picked by its own topic_text field while also belonging to the actor's single workspace (team_id=T01WORKSPACE); other channels in that same workspace have distinct topic domains or are already archived, so only one conversation satisfies both the workspace scope and the topic wording.

roles.facts: C_INFRA, channel_name='core-infra', team_id=T01WORKSPACE, topic_text='Infrastructure, K8s, AWS, on-call, incidents', is_archived=false, actor is a member
roles.reason: Exact topic wording (K8s/AWS/on-call/incidents) uniquely names this channel within the workspace

roles.facts: T01WORKSPACE, the only workspace the actor belongs to; all candidate channels share this team_id
roles.reason: Provides the workspace binding along the CONVERSATION→WORKSPACE route that scopes candidate channels

roles.facts: C_MODEL, channel_name='model-research', team_id=T01WORKSPACE, topic_text='Model training, evals, papers, architectures'
roles.reason: Same workspace but topic concerns ML research, not infra/on-call, so it fails the attribute condition

roles.facts: C_GROWTH, channel_name='product-growth', team_id=T01WORKSPACE, topic_text='User metrics, A/B tests, expansion, APAC'
C_FRONTEND, channel_name='frontend', team_id=T01WORKSPACE, topic_text='React, TypeScript, UI/UX, design system'

roles.reason: Generic engineering topic with no K8s/AWS/on-call wording, so the topic condition excludes it despite plausible domain overlap

roles.facts: C_OLD_PROJECT, channel_name='old-project-q3', team_id=T01WORKSPACE, topic_text='Q3 2025 Project - ARCHIVED', is_archived=true
roles.reason: Unrelated project topic and already archived, so it cannot be the target of a fresh archive action nor match the infra topic wording

obligations.name: archive_infra_channel
obligations.description: Select the single conversation in the actor's workspace whose stored topic_text names Kubernetes/AWS/on-call incident response, then archive it (set channels.is_archived to true).
obligations.scope: the one non-archived channel in team_id=T01WORKSPACE with topic_text matching the K8s/AWS/on-call/incidents wording

task_spec.text: Identify the workspace channel whose topic covers Kubernetes, AWS, and on-call incident response.

design.access_plan: Use conversations.list (or users.conversations) scoped to the actor's workspace/types to enumerate channels and their topic_text via conversations.info, compare against the requested wording to isolate the single matching, non-archived channel, then call conversations.archive on its channel ID (setting channels.is_archived to true).
